text: Kakhovka dam. Our task is to clear enemy aircraft from the area. The dam itself is not a target.
Understood. Down there are water, power and people’s homes. No jokes here.
There is no retreat. Our forces are simply clearing space. Very efficiently. And, for some reason, farther and farther from the dragon.
They can call their retreat whatever they like. We care about what people are left with afterwards.
Then we protect the sky and what is beneath it. Moving out.
